recognize_zh: 高倍下成片大型淋巴樣細胞，核大圓形至卵圓形、泡狀，許多細胞有明顯單一或邊緣性核仁，部分染色質呈模糊（smudged）外觀，並有凋亡碎片，符合大 B 細胞淋巴瘤（中心母細胞／免疫母細胞樣）。
features: Diffuse sheets of large lymphoid cells, nuclei 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte
Round to oval vesicular nuclei, some with irregular or indented contours
Prominent single central or peripheral nucleoli in many cells (immunoblastic/centroblastic)
Areas of smudged, hyperchromatic crushed chromatin
Scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm; apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures present
Scattered small vessels with plump endothelial cells
describe_en: Section shows diffuse sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, frequent prominent central or peripheral nucleoli, and scant to moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Some nuclei show smudged, hyperchromatic chromatin, and apoptotic bodies and mitotic figures are readily identified. No follicular architecture or significant small-lymphocyte background is seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a large B-cell lymphoma; with cutaneous location and a CD20+, BCL2+, MUM1+ phenotype, they support primary cutaneous diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leg type.

ddx.vs: PCFCL cells are predominantly large centrocytes (cleaved) rather than round centroblasts/immunoblasts and are BCL2 and MUM1 negative.
Myeloid blasts have finer chromatin, may show eosinophilic myelocytes, and express MPO/lysozyme/CD33 rather than CD20.
Merkel cells have salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and express CK20 (dot-like) and neuroendocrine markers.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD20 negative and CD138/MUM1 positive with plasmacytoid cytoplasm, often EBER positive.
